en.description: Brown, crispy leaf tips usually point to dry air, uneven watering, salt build-up or sensitive plants reacting to tap water. How to find which, and fix it.

es.description: Las puntas secas y marrones suelen deberse a aire seco, riego irregular, sales acumuladas o sensibilidad al agua del grifo. Cómo saber cuál y corregirlo.
